defendant: Darrell Lea Chocolate Shops Pty Ltd
charges: Contravention of ss 52, 53(c) and 53(d) of the Trade Practices Act 1974 (Cth) and passing off constituted by Darrell Lea's use in its chocolate confectionery business of a shade of purple in which Cadbury claims it has a 'substantial, exclusive and valuable reputation and good will'.
counsel_for_applicant: A J Myers QC and MD Wyles
